voice-branch-jargon.notes: [EXPIRED-NO-FIELD-HASH] Fixed. The block no longer reads as a maintenance dashboard against roadmap tiers. "dashboard" is dropped from the remark title and body; "the live per-observable accuracy dashboard ... first-class, auto-regenerated artifact" is now a plain statement of what the witness records; the "**Wiring.**" paragraph loses run_pipeline.py and the auto-regeneration sweeps, keeping only the fact that the witness is recomputed when its inputs change and so does not go stale silently. The roadmap tiers L1/L2 are gone: "the precision-goal L2 leg" is now "its 100x absolute-accuracy target against experiment", and the docs/precision-goals.md pointer is replaced by a "Scope of the target" paragraph stating the same three things in the paper's voice — two accuracy sub-goals measuring absolute accuracy, distinct from internal compute agreement, both bounded below by the CAL-2 floor. The 100x target formula, the seven observables, the summary field names and the admission that the remainder do not meet the target all survive.
